nodes.name: Normal Plasma Nitridation
nodes.procedure: The Ni plate and N2 are directly applied as nickel and nitrogen sources to achieve Ni3N by typical radio frequency plasma system.
nodes.source_text: According to the typical schematic procedure (Figure 2a), the Ni plate and N2 are directly applied as nickel and nitrogen sources to achieve Ni3N by our typical radio frequency plasma system

nodes.name: Cooling Assisted Plasma Nitridation
nodes.procedure: The auxiliary cooling system is introduced simultaneously with plasma processing in order to reduce the surface heating effect through the continuous collision of reactive species with substrates. The resultant nickel nitrides are termed cp-Ni3N obtained by plasma processing with auxiliary cooling.
nodes.source_text: Comparatively, the auxiliary cooling system is introduced simultaneously with plasma processing... The resultant nickel nitrides are termed p-Ni3N and cp-Ni3N obtained by plasma processing without and with auxiliary cooling, respectively.

unit_operations.name: Plasma Processing with Cooling
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: the auxiliary cooling system is introduced simultaneously with plasma processing in order to reduce the surface heating effect

nodes.name: Thermal Nitridation at 500°C
nodes.procedure: Ni plate is thermally nitrided using NH3 annealing at 500°C, generating highly roughened frameworks on the Ni surface, suggesting nickel nitride formation.
nodes.source_text: the surface morphology of prepared Ni3N is apparently different based on NH3 annealing from 400 to 600°C. For Ni3N-400... With raised nitriding temperature at 500°C (Figure 4a), highly roughened frameworks are generated on the Ni surface

unit_operations.name: NH3 Annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: NH3 annealing from 400 to 600°C... With raised nitriding temperature at 500°C

properties.description: T-Ni3-500 catalyst or material, likely annealed at 500°C

nodes.source_text: Electrochemical tests are further applied to investigate the HER performance of resulting catalysts based on a three-electrode configuration with 1M NaOH and Hg/HgO as counter and reference electrodes. In terms of IR-corrected linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) curves (Figure 3a), cp-Ni₃N presents much enhanced electrocatalytic activity with an overpotential of 58 mV at a current density of 10mAcm⁻²... The Tafel slope of cp-Ni₃N is 64mVdec⁻¹... the cp-Ni₃N electrode provides an increased slope of 78mVdec⁻¹ after cycling.
cp-Ni₃N presents much enhanced electrocatalytic activity with an overpotential of 58 mV at a current density of 10mAcm⁻²(j₁₀), much lower than that of p-Ni₃N (93mV) and pure Ni (203 mV).
cp-Ni₃N presents much enhanced electrocatalytic activity with an overpotential of 58 mV at a current density of 10mAcm⁻²(j₁₀), much lower than that of p-Ni₃N (93mV) and pure Ni (203 mV).
Pt/C electrode commonly achieves the lowest j₁₀ of 38mV,and our cp Ni₃N is almost comparable with a noble metal-based catalyst.

As exhibited in Figure 4d... the overpotential of T-Ni₃N-500 is 58 mV at j₁₀, similar to that of cp-Ni₃N. With increased current densities, thermally-nitrified Ni₃N delivers the overpotentials of 154 and 209 mV at j₅₀ and j₁₀₀, higher than that of cp-Ni₃N.

nodes.characterization_summary: cp-Ni₃N shows almost two times higher (2-10) peak intensity than p-Ni₃N after normalization by (2-11) intensity; both show hexagonal Ni₃N peaks at 39.3°, 42.1°, 44.6°, 58.7° for (2-10), (002), (2-11), (2-12).
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to the normalized XRD pattern by the intensity of Ni₃N (2-11) (Figure S9, Supporting Information), it is observed that the intensity of Ni₃N (2-10) in cp-Ni₃N is almost two times higher than that in p-Ni₃N...

nodes.characterization_summary: cp-Ni₃N exhibits nanocoralline structure with mean diameters of 45 nm; p-Ni₃N nano-corals are 22 nm with much-increased roughness; T-Ni₃N-500 shows highly roughened frameworks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to surface morphology, cp-Ni₃N exhibits a nanocoralline structure (Figure 2c) with mean diameters of 45 nm. Comparatively, the nano-corals of p-Ni₃N are 22 nm with much-increased roughness (Figure S10, Supporting Information).

properties.description: High-resolution scanning electron microscopy image showing nanostructured material with fibrous or porous morphology

nodes.characterization_summary: cp-Ni₃N exposed facets are mainly (2-10); p-Ni₃N and T-Ni₃N-500 mainly show (2-11) facets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In terms of TEM results of cp-Ni₃N (Figure 2d), the exposed facets are mainly (2-10), in comparison with (2-11) of p-Ni₃N... Based on TEM characterization, thermal-nitrided Ni₃N mainly delivers the (2-11) facet on its surface...

nodes.characterization_summary: Both samples provide typical peaks at 160, 199, and 228 cm⁻¹ indicating Ni-N, Ni-Ni, and N-N-N vibrations, confirming pure Ni₃N formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: According to Raman spectra (Figure 2e), both samples provide typical peaks at 160, 199, and 228 cm⁻¹ indicating the Ni-N, Ni-Ni, and N-N-N vibrations, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: N 1s shows peak at 398.3 eV for Ni-N bonding; cp-Ni₃N has NiNx/NiOx ratio of 2.37 vs 1.51 for p-Ni₃N; Ni 2p shows 854.0 eV peak for Ni-N bonding.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In terms of XPS N 1s results (Figure 2f), both metal nitrides... deliver a typical peak centered at 398.3 eV indicating the Ni-N bonding (NiNx formation)... For XPS Ni 2p comparison (Figure 2g), critical peaks at 854.0 eV are observed...

nodes.characterization_summary: Cdl values: cp-Ni₃N 30.7 mF cm⁻², p-Ni₃N 38.0 mF cm⁻², Ni 15.2 mF cm⁻².
nodes.evidence_snippet: Among all samples, the Cdl of p-Ni₃N is 38.0 mF cm⁻², higher than that of cp-Ni₃N (30.7 mF cm⁻²), and initial Ni (15.2 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: cp-Ni₃N shows Rct of 3.2 Ω, p-Ni₃N 13.5 Ω, Ni 26.7 Ω.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cp-Ni₃N catalyst exhibits a charge transfer resistance (Rct) of 3.2 Ω, significantly smaller than that of p-Ni₃N (13.5 Ω) and Ni (26.7 Ω)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃N-related peaks remain apparent during HER without shift, indicating excellent stability of cp-Ni₃N.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 3g, Ni₃N-related peaks are apparent during the catalytic process without any shift, indicating the excellent stability of cp-Ni₃N.
